title: Ultimate Claw Experience at Claw Arcade
includes: Admission to the arcade and tokens to play
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please note that you can only use your ticket once, If you redeem your 20 or 50 tokens you cannot use your ticket again, and you need to purchase new token at the arcade.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This isn’t just an arcade. It’s the thrill of the win. The friendly competition. The laughter when someone finally grabs that prize on the last try. It’s family fun nights, date nights, and those spontaneous “let’s go do something fun” moments. Your arcade is clean, vibrant, and designed for excitement the moment you walk in. Kids love it. Teens get competitive. Adults get hooked. Everyone walks away smiling.
